errors.text_span: erreicht ein Maximum von etwa 88 % im Alter von 45 Jahren
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence describes the grey line. The grey line's maximum is approximately 82-83%, not 88%. 88% is the approximate maximum of the black line.
The description incorrectly identifies the light blue line as dashed ('gestrichelt'); it is a solid line.

errors.text_span: steigt bis zu einem Maximum von etwa 80 % im Alter von 45 Jahren
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence describes the light blue line. While a peak of around 80% is reached (at age 23), the value at age 45 is only about 72%.
The description incorrectly identifies the dark blue line as dashed ('gestrichelt'); it is a solid line.
The description claims the dark blue line has triangular markers, but all lines in the chart have circular markers.

errors.text_span: steigt bis zu einem Maximum von etwa 70 % im Alter von 50 Jahren
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence describes the dark blue line. The maximum of about 70% is reached at age 57, not 50. At age 50, the value is closer to 58%.

errors.text_span: fällt dann bis auf etwa 10 % im Alter von 70 Jahren
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence describes the dark blue line. The line drops to or very near 0% by age 70, not 10%. It hits 0% at ages 64 and 67.
